sollar.definition:
n. See Solar, n.
n. A platform in a shaft, especially one of those between the
   series of ladders in a shaft.
v. t. To cover, or provide with, a sollar.
sollar.translation: [采矿]竖井梯子间平台, [建]敞亮阁楼间, 敞亮顶楼层

solleret.definition: n armor plate that protects the foot; consists of mail with a solid toe and heel
solleret.translation: n. (中古时期武士铠甲的)钢甲靴

sollux.translation: [医] 索鲁克斯灯(红线及红外线)
